description.narrative: (Liberia): In USAID's FY 2022 Liberia Country Roadmap, civil society and media effectiveness ranked .90 out of 1 (one being the "ideal" scenario), confirming the opportunity that exists to capitalize on the media's ability to promote government accountability and reforms that align with both U.S. and Liberian priorities. Still, Liberia suffers from a lack of high-quality, independent media capability. USAID's support to independent media in Liberia will continue to strengthen the sustainability and capacity of journalists and media institutions to deliver professional, ethical, and credible information to the public on the key issues of the day. .Using FY 2022 resources, the media activity will strengthen the capacity of the Liberian media to serve as a conduit for information between citizens and the government. The activity will support citizen engagement and encourage participation in national-level dialogues. Interventions will include: 1) supporting community radio stations; 2) engaging with diverse groups to utilize new media to disseminate objective news stories; 3) supporting marginalized voices including female journalists; and 4) improving the regulatory framework.
